observed_missing_fields.budget_kb_applied: ABSENT from the response despite 6 sections being genuinely trimmed

mechanism: platform-mcp/src/tools/register_p1_ganita.ts:155-168 `function dualOutput(data)` calls `applyAutoBudgetToEnvelope(obj, toolName)` (toolName correctly resolved from obj['tool'], confirmed by the correct recover_via names above) instead of the stronger `finalizeMcpBudget`. `applyAutoBudgetToEnvelope` is defined at platform-mcp/src/lib/response_budget.ts:584-598: it calls `applyResponseBudget` and appends the resulting trim_report to the envelope, but — unlike `finalizeMcpBudget` (same file, lines 361-441, which explicitly sets `mutable['budget_kb_applied']`/`budget_kb_requested` at lines 380-381 and merges `recover_via` into drill_pointers at line 384) — it does neither. response_budget.ts's own doc-comment on applyAutoBudgetToEnvelope (line 575-582) names this as the shared wiring point for 'every dualOutput() in register_p1_ganita.ts / register_p1_synthesis.ts / register_p1_aliases.ts ... (ganita_condition_get, kala_life_arc_get, kala_projections_get, ganita_positions_get, mimamsa_lel_query, and the rest of the estate)' — implying this missing-honesty-echo gap plausibly extends beyond ganita_planet_get to that whole list, though only ganita_planet_get (and, per a separate evidence file, ganita_database_schema_get) were live-verified in this pass.
corroborating_note: ganita_database_schema_get (chart schema tool, registered elsewhere) was also observed missing a top-level budget_kb_applied field in its trimmed response (budget_kb=1 request produced a trim_report with a correct real recover_via name but no visible budget_kb_applied echo), suggesting this is not isolated to a single file/tool.
